description: Give 1-16 funded pledges in YOUR locked pool the outcome your PUBLISHED result names for them (publish the result first; anything else is refused `result_required` / `outcome_not_in_result`): `burn` destroys exactly the pool's stake from that pledge's account (a real token burn, supply falls), `release` frees it for its pledger to withdraw. Each pledge gets one outcome, once. A burn whose result is unknown is parked and never re-sent. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.
name: signet_pledge_outcomes
title: Signet pledge pool — give outcomes (organiser)
